description:
Web sphere Integration Developer (WID) or Web sphere Process Server (WPS) developer .
 The developer will join the Cargo IT team in implementing a services oriented architecture (SOA) running on the IBM Web sphere middleware stack (Web sphere Application Server (WAS), Web sphere Enterprise Service Bus (WESB) and Web sphere Process Server (WPS).The platform will integrate data from legacy and external systems coming through Message Queue (MQ) and other formats and interface to Oracle databases as well as web service interfaces to other systems. Projects are implemented using an agile methodology to incrementally deliver business value. 
 Strong background in Java Enterprise Edition (JEE) development is required. Experience with enterprise integration design patterns, JPA, Web sphere MQ, SQL, Agile, performance tuning, and web services technologies (WSDL/SOAP) are strongly desired. 
 


 • Bachelor degree in computer science or equivalent training required Skills 
 • Knowledge of circuit boards, processors, electronic equipment and computer hardware and software (Required) 
 • Knowledge of niche computer software, such as Oracle, CSharp.net, Lawson, etc (Required) 
 


 Technologies Required: 
 JPA, Web sphere MQ, SQL, Agile, performance tuning, web services technologies (WSDL/SOAP) are strongly desired
